subject.title: docs: note LanceDB dreaming v0.2.3 via memory-lancedb-dreaming plugin

question: Should OpenClaw core docs carry a generic LanceDB/vector-native dreaming caveat, or should this community plugin version availability stay entirely on ClawHub?
rationale: The exact requested package/version note is plugin promotion that VISION.md routes to ClawHub, but the linked PR proposes a generic core behavior clarification that may still be useful if maintainers sponsor it.

options.title: Keep core docs generic
options.body: Land or revise the linked PR so it explains slot-owned Dreaming settings and points vector-native implementations to ClawHub without naming a package version.

options.title: Keep availability ClawHub-only
options.body: Close the linked docs PR and this issue with a clear note that live package availability, release history, and install hints belong on ClawHub.
